findings.disposition: Bearer認証・起動リンク交換、UDP/DNS監査を追加。HTTP負例とsecurity_guardsで確認。

findings.topic: 旧原本の欠損検出がDB切替後になる
findings.disposition: 原本存在/SHAを切替前に検査し、旧DB保持と再試行を追加。実プロセス中断を含む回帰検査。

findings.topic: 復元用PWを忘れた後のバックアップ不能
findings.disposition: Windows鍵で開ける間のPW再設定、旧ZIPの新PW確認入力を追加。

findings.topic: 大量の不足原本一覧が状態ファイル上限を超える
findings.disposition: 不足件数だけを保存し、復元先を開けることをmarker解除前に検証するよう修正。300件の原本欠損を復元・再起動する回帰検査が成功。
findings.status: implemented and verified by actual300missing restore/reopen regression; no claim of post-fix model approval

findings.topic: 失敗した復元先の再起動拒否
findings.disposition: Storeの起動時にRESTORE_FAILED/RESTORE_IN_PROGRESSを拒否する契約がある。提示範囲外の確認事項として扱い、security_guardsで検査。

findings.topic: 旧ZIPは作成者の真正性を証明しない
findings.disposition: 旧形式は件数・DB・原本の自己一貫性のみ。自分で作成した旧バックアップを復元する制約を文書化。

findings.topic: 日本語の保護範囲と復元手順
findings.disposition: 双方の鍵喪失、CSV非暗号化、過去バックアップのPW不変、救出用バックアップの限界、スマホ未対応を明記。永久に原本を失うという過大表現は採用しない。
findings.status: copy fixes implemented and browser workflow verified; latest narrow Japanese review recorded separately

ui_dispositions.topic: Repeated results rebuild loses focus, OCR and previews
ui_dispositions.disposition: Keyed incremental rows and viewport-based authenticated image loading; actual held-worker regression passed.
uiReady guard, inert navigation and init readiness after detail load; restart compatibility regression passed.

ui_dispositions.topic: Completed records without preview labelled processing
ui_dispositions.disposition: Busy/completed labels separated; original remains available in review screen.

ui_dispositions.topic: Conditional stale held row after last job, or eviction across page/filter
ui_dispositions.disposition: Focusout, OCR close and zoom close refresh from saved state; defer interaction eviction including empty results. Dedicated last-job and empty-filter browser regressions passed.

ui_dispositions.topic: Zoom scale, duplicate CSV save, skip link and repeated home announcement
ui_dispositions.disposition: Natural pixel zoom, single-flight CSV with captured filename, main-workspace skip link, stable home/pager DOM. These are implemented changes, not a blanket model quality approval.
